recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a current workflow needs inline attachments in a manifest-like collection, handle that as a new current-release decision against List, DocumentReference, or another active artifact rather than reopening this retired DocumentManifest tracker.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 request to update DocumentManifest.content to content[x] 1..* allowing Attachment or a resource pointer to DocumentReference or Media, while dropping Binary because Binary alone lacked technical context.
initial_application: Git commit 289d5edc33dcd7b4955566c5876f6613a7112eb2 explicitly applied FHIR-5877 by adding DocumentManifest.content.p[x] 1..1 Attachment|Reference(DocumentReference|Media) to the historical DocumentManifest spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Published issue FHIR-12655 later removed the Attachment alternative after FM confirmed it was no longer using DocumentManifest for attachment workflows; commit 94e532a611046fcdc40df2d7d28457eeb7dad3a6 applied that reversal and changed content to Reference(Any), with FHIR-13534 broadening the resource narrative. FHIR-33021 and its linked Zulip thread record the later retirement path because IHE MHD had moved from DocumentManifest to List, and FHIR-39006 moved XDS mappings/examples into List. Current fhir.ini has no active documentmanifest resource and maps the old type to List; current history records DocumentManifest as removed with use List.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No current source change is appropriate because re-adding Attachment would contradict FHIR-12655 and there is no active DocumentManifest content model in the current build.
